sections.title: String operations
sections.content:
```ruby
s = '  Hello, World  '

# Inspection
s.length            # 15
s.empty?            # false
s.include?('World') # true

# Transformation (return NEW string)
s.strip             # 'Hello, World'   (trim whitespace)
s.upcase            # '  HELLO, WORLD  '
s.downcase          # '  hello, world  '
s.reverse           # '  dlroW ,olleH  '
s.chomp             # remove trailing NEWLINE only

# Bang versions MUTATE in place:
s2 = 'hi'; s2.upcase!; s2  # 'HI'

# Split / Join
'a,b,c'.split(',')         # ['a','b','c']
'one two three'.split(/\s+/)  # ['one','two','three']
['a','b'].join('-')        # 'a-b'

# Replace
'hello'.gsub('l', 'L')      # 'heLLo' (all)
'hello'.sub('l', 'L')       # 'heLlo' (first only)
'a1b2'.gsub(/\d/) { |d| d.to_i * 2 }  # 'a2b4'

# Access / slice
s = 'hello'
s[0]              # 'h'
s[-1]             # 'o' (negative from end)
s[0..2]           # 'hel' (slice, inclusive)
s.start_with?('he')  # true
s.end_with?('lo')    # true

# Convert
'42'.to_i         # 42
'3.14'.to_f       # 3.14
'x'.to_sym        # :x
42.to_s           # '42'

# Concatenate / repeat
'ab' + 'cd'       # 'abcd'
'ab' << 'cd'      # 'abcd' (<< mutates)
'ab' * 3          # 'ababab'
```

Ruby strings have rich methods.

Inspection: s.length, s.empty?, s.include?('sub').

A common mistake is forgetting gsub returns a new string (use gsub! to mutate), or chomp vs strip (chomp removes only trailing newline).

sections.title: String operations
sections.content:
```ruby
s = '  Hello, World  '

# Inspection
s.length            # 15
s.empty?            # false
s.include?('World') # true

# Transformation (return NEW string)
s.strip             # 'Hello, World'   (trim whitespace)
s.upcase            # '  HELLO, WORLD  '
s.downcase          # '  hello, world  '
s.reverse           # '  dlroW ,olleH  '
s.chomp             # remove trailing NEWLINE only

# Bang versions MUTATE in place:
s2 = 'hi'; s2.upcase!; s2  # 'HI'

# Split / Join
'a,b,c'.split(',')         # ['a','b','c']
'one two three'.split(/\s+/)  # ['one','two','three']
['a','b'].join('-')        # 'a-b'

# Replace
'hello'.gsub('l', 'L')      # 'heLLo' (all)
'hello'.sub('l', 'L')       # 'heLlo' (first only)
'a1b2'.gsub(/\d/) { |d| d.to_i * 2 }  # 'a2b4'

# Access / slice
s = 'hello'
s[0]              # 'h'
s[-1]             # 'o' (negative from end)
s[0..2]           # 'hel' (slice, inclusive)
s.start_with?('he')  # true
s.end_with?('lo')    # true

# Convert
'42'.to_i         # 42
'3.14'.to_f       # 3.14
'x'.to_sym        # :x
42.to_s           # '42'

# Concatenate / repeat
'ab' + 'cd'       # 'abcd'
'ab' << 'cd'      # 'abcd' (<< mutates)
'ab' * 3          # 'ababab'
```
